summary: Density-one Hasse principle for Fano hypersurfaces except cubic surfaces, and the sharp typical least-point height, via lattice counting, a variance bound and local-factor lower tails. Basic lattice/covolume and homogeneous-polynomial carriers are reused; quantitative lattice estimates go to GN, family and local-density interfaces to ST, and a Part II of Heights covers random Fano hypersurfaces. Complete (cc-442dc5) on arXiv v1: every proof was checked, the checkpoint's thirteen findings were confirmed and six more recorded. The published text is unavailable (G1). Not formalised.

items.name: Coefficient family and Euclidean height
items.statement: N=binomial(n+d,d); V_{d,n}=P^{N-1}(Q). Each V has primitive integral coefficient vectors ±a_V; h(V)=||a_V||. For real A≥1 put V(A)={V:h(V)≤A}. This counts embedded equations up to scalar, not Q-isomorphism classes.
items.note: Statement and locator refer to the 2020 preprint; publication reconciliation remains open.

items.name: Everywhere locally soluble family
items.statement: V^loc={V:V(A_Q)≠∅}, with V^loc(A)=V^loc∩V(A). For a projective hypersurface this is equivalent to nontrivial zeros over R and every Q_p.
items.note: Statement and locator refer to the 2020 preprint; publication reconciliation remains open.

items.name: Global and local density ratios
items.statement: rho(A)=#{V∈V(A):V(Q)≠∅}/#V(A); rho^loc=lim_{A→∞}#V^loc(A)/#V(A) when the limit exists. The denominator counts all coefficient classes.
items.note: Statement and locator refer to the 2020 preprint; publication reconciliation remains open.

items.name: Anticanonical point height
items.statement: For x∈P^n(Q), choose primitive x_Z∈Z^{n+1}; H(x)=||x_Z||^{n+1-d}. This is well-defined because the two choices are ±x_Z and n+1-d≥1.
items.note: Statement and locator refer to the 2020 preprint; publication reconciliation remains open.

items.name: Rational point counting function
items.statement: For B>0 let N_V(B)=#{x∈V(Q):H(x)≤B}. This is a finite nonnegative integer.
items.note: Statement and locator refer to the 2020 preprint; publication reconciliation remains open.

items.name: Integer orthogonal kernel
items.statement: For N≥1 and c∈Z^N let Lambda_c={y∈Z^N:<c,y>=0}. It is a saturated integral lattice; for c≠0 its rank is N−1.
items.note: Statement and locator refer to the 2020 preprint; publication reconciliation remains open.

items.name: Unweighted monomial evaluation vector
items.statement: For integers d,n≥1, nu_{d,n}:R^{n+1}→R^N lists every degree-d monomial once in lexicographic order, with no multinomial square-root weights. For a coefficient vector a, f_a(x)=<a,nu(x)>.
items.locator: arXiv v1, Def.2.1 p.4; Def.3.10 p.12
items.note: Statement and locator refer to the 2020 preprint; publication reconciliation remains open.

items.name: Primitive height ball
items.note: Statement and locator refer to the 2020 preprint; publication reconciliation remains open.

items.name: Incidence double counting
items.statement: For V∈V_{d,n} and B>0, N_V(B)=(1/2) sum_{x∈Xi(B), a_V∈Lambda_{nu(x)}}1.
items.note: Statement and locator refer to the 2020 preprint; publication reconciliation remains open.

items.name: Homogeneous angular band
items.statement: For N≥1, gamma>0 and v∈R^N, C_v^(gamma)={t:|<v,t>|≤||v|| ||t||/(2gamma)}.
items.note: Statement and locator refer to the 2020 preprint; publication reconciliation remains open.

items.name: Congruence kernel lattice
items.statement: For positive integer Q and c∈Z^N, Lambda_c^(Q)={y∈Z^N:<c,y>≡0 mod Q}. This has full rank, unlike Lambda_c for nonzero c.
items.note: Statement and locator refer to the 2020 preprint; publication reconciliation remains open.

items.name: Archimedean scale
items.statement: For B sufficiently large define alpha(B)=log B>0.
items.note: Statement and locator refer to the 2020 preprint; publication reconciliation remains open.

items.name: Prime cutoff
items.statement: For B sufficiently large define w(B)=log B/log log B.
items.note: Statement and locator refer to the 2020 preprint; publication reconciliation remains open.

items.name: Growing highly divisible modulus
items.statement: For w=w(B)>1, W(B)=product_{p prime,p≤w} p^{ceil(log w/log p)+1}; rad(W)=product_{p≤w}p.
items.note: Statement and locator refer to the 2020 preprint; publication reconciliation remains open.

items.name: Size of the smoothing modulus
items.statement: As B→∞, log W(B)~3w(B), hence W(B)≪B^{4/log log B}. The prime number theorem is used.
items.note: Statement and locator refer to the 2020 preprint; publication reconciliation remains open.

items.name: Localized point count
items.statement: N_V^loc(B)=alpha(B)W(B)/(2||a_V||) times sum of 1/||nu(x)|| over x∈Xi(B) satisfying a_V∈Lambda_{nu(x)}^(W)∩C_{nu(x)}^(alpha).
items.note: Statement and locator refer to the 2020 preprint; publication reconciliation remains open.

items.name: Least rational-point height
items.statement: M(V)=min_{x∈V(Q)}H(x) if V(Q)≠∅ and M(V)=+∞ otherwise, in the extended nonnegative reals.
items.note: Statement and locator refer to the 2020 preprint; publication reconciliation remains open.

items.name: Density-one Hasse principle
items.statement: For d≥2, n≥d and (d,n)≠(3,3), lim_{A→∞}rho_{d,n}(A)=rho^loc_{d,n}. In particular the density of locally soluble but insoluble equations among all V(A) is zero.
items.note: Statement and locator refer to the 2020 preprint; publication reconciliation remains open.

items.name: Positive proportion with rational points
items.statement: For d≥2, n≥d and (d,n)≠(2,2), liminf_{A→∞}rho_{d,n}(A)>0. This includes cubic surfaces but does not assert their density-one Hasse principle.
items.note: Statement and locator refer to the 2020 preprint; publication reconciliation remains open. The cubic-surface case uses bhargava-plane-cubics through an inscribed coefficient box.

items.name: Almost sure least-point upper scale
items.statement: For d≥2, n≥d, (d,n)≠(3,3), and any psi:R_{>0}→R_{>0} with psi(u)/u→∞, the ratio #{V∈V(A):M(V)≤psi(||a_V||)}/#V(A) tends to rho^loc_{d,n}. No monotonicity of psi is assumed.
items.note: Statement and locator refer to the 2020 preprint; publication reconciliation remains open.

items.name: Optimal typical least-point scale
items.statement: For d≥2, n≥d and (d,n) outside {(2,2),(3,3)}, any xi:R_{>0}→R_{>0} tending to infinity satisfies 1/xi(||a_V||)<M(V)/||a_V||≤xi(||a_V||) for density one of V^loc, ordered by ||a_V||. Uses Le Boudec Thm.1 as well as Thm.2.2.
items.note: Statement and locator refer to the 2020 preprint; publication reconciliation remains open.

items.name: Global/localized discrepancy tail
items.statement: For d≥2,n≥d excluding (2,2),(3,3), and phi:R_{>0}→R_{>1} with phi(A)≤(log A)^{1/2} for sufficiently large A, #{V∈V(A):|N_V(Aphi(A))−N_V^loc(Aphi(A))|>phi(A)^{2/3}}/#V(A)≪phi(A)^{−1/3}.
items.note: Statement and locator refer to the 2020 preprint; publication reconciliation remains open.

items.name: Localized count lower tail
items.statement: For d≥2,n≥d excluding (2,2), and phi:R_{>0}→R_{>1} with phi(A)≤A^{3/n} for sufficiently large A, #{V∈V^loc(A):N_V^loc(Aphi(A))≤phi(A)^{2/3}}/#V^loc(A)≪phi(A)^{−1/(24n)}.
items.note: Statement and locator refer to the 2020 preprint; publication reconciliation remains open.

items.name: Logarithmic exceptional-set estimate
items.statement: For d≥2,n≥d excluding (3,3), #{V∈V^loc(A):V(Q)=∅}/#V(A)≪(log A)^{−1/(48n)}. For (2,2), use Hasse–Minkowski; for the other cases choose phi(A)=(log A)^{1/2} in Propositions 2.3–2.4.
items.note: Statement and locator refer to the 2020 preprint; publication reconciliation remains open.

items.name: Discrete lattice in its span
items.statement: A lattice Lambda⊂R^N is a discrete additive subgroup. Its rank R is dim_R span_R Lambda; regard Lambda as a full lattice in that span, including R=0.
items.note: Paper-specialized statement; no declaration for the quantitative assertion was found at the pins.

items.name: Intrinsic covolume
items.statement: For a rank-R lattice and any Z-basis with column matrix B∈M_{N,R}(R), det(Lambda)=sqrt(det(B^t B)), with empty determinant 1. This is intrinsic R-dimensional covolume.
items.note: Paper-specialized statement; no declaration for the quantitative assertion was found at the pins.

items.name: Orthogonal quotient lattice
items.statement: If Gamma≤Lambda and span_R(Gamma)∩Lambda=Gamma, let Lambda/Gamma=pi(Lambda), where pi is orthogonal projection to span_R(Gamma)^perp. It is a lattice of rank rank(Lambda)−rank(Gamma), with covolume det(Lambda)/det(Gamma).
items.note: Paper-specialized statement; no declaration for the quantitative assertion was found at the pins.

items.name: Primitive integral lattice
items.statement: An integral lattice is a lattice Lambda⊂Z^N; it is primitive iff span_R(Lambda)∩Z^N=Lambda, equivalently it is not properly contained in another integral lattice of the same rank.
items.note: Paper-specialized statement; no declaration for the quantitative assertion was found at the pins.

items.name: Integral orthogonal lattice
items.statement: Lambda^perp={a∈Z^N:∀z∈Lambda,<a,z>=0}. It is primitive of rank N−rank Lambda. Double perpendicular is the saturation; for primitive Lambda it equals Lambda and det(Lambda^perp)=det(Lambda).
items.note: Paper-specialized statement; no declaration for the quantitative assertion was found at the pins.

items.name: Euclidean dual lattice
items.statement: For Lambda⊂R^N define Lambda*={a∈span_R Lambda:∀z∈Lambda,<a,z>∈Z}. It has the same rank and det(Lambda*)=det(Lambda)^{-1}. The ambient space restriction is essential.
items.note: Paper-specialized statement; no declaration for the quantitative assertion was found at the pins.

items.name: Dual of primitive perpendicular
items.statement: For primitive Lambda⊂Z^N, (Lambda^perp)*=Z^N/Lambda, with the right side the orthogonal quotient lattice.
items.note: Paper-specialized statement; no declaration for the quantitative assertion was found at the pins.

items.name: Successive Euclidean minima
items.statement: For 1≤R≤N and rank-R Lambda⊂R^N, lambda_i(Lambda)=inf{u>0:dim_R span_R(Lambda∩B_N(u))≥i}, for 1≤i≤R.
items.note: Paper-specialized statement; no declaration for the quantitative assertion was found at the pins.

items.name: Product of successive minima
items.statement: For rank-R Euclidean lattice, R≥1, det(Lambda)≤product_{i=1}^R lambda_i(Lambda)≪_R det(Lambda).
items.note: Paper-specialized statement; no declaration for the quantitative assertion was found at the pins.

items.name: Banaszczyk transference
items.statement: For 1≤R≤N, rank-R Euclidean lattice Lambda and 1≤i≤R, lambda_i(Lambda) lambda_{R−i+1}(Lambda*)≤R.
items.locator: arXiv v1, Lemma 3.3 p.8; cited [1] Thm.2.1
items.note: Paper-specialized statement; no declaration for the quantitative assertion was found at the pins.

items.name: Counting in intersections of angular bands
items.statement: Let N≥2,1≤R≤N,1≤I≤N−1, Lambda a rank-R lattice, v_1,...,v_I∈R^N, gamma>0, Y≥lambda_R(Lambda), and T≥Y. Set R_v(T,gamma)=B_N(T)∩intersection_i C_{v_i}^(gamma) and V_v=vol_R(span_R Lambda∩R_v(1,gamma)). Then #(Lambda∩R_v(T,gamma))=T^R/det(Lambda)*(V_v+O(Y/T)). The paper states O_R; dependence on family complexity I versus R still needs verification (gap G4); a fixed N,I specialization is supported by Barroero–Widmer.
items.note: Paper-specialized statement; no declaration for the quantitative assertion was found at the pins. The implied constant depends on R and on the number I of bands (E15); every application has I ≤ 2.

items.name: Successive-minima ball count
items.statement: For rank-R Lambda⊂R^N,1≤R≤N,T≥1, #(Lambda∩B_N(T))≪_R sum_{i=0}^R T^{R−i}/product_{j=1}^{R−i}lambda_j(Lambda), with empty product 1.
items.locator: arXiv v1, Lemma 3.5 pp.9–10, first part
items.note: Paper-specialized statement; no declaration for the quantitative assertion was found at the pins.

items.name: Ball count using an intermediate minimum
items.statement: For rank-R Lambda,1≤i0≤R and T≥lambda_{i0}(Lambda), #(Lambda∩B_N(T))≪_R T^R/(lambda_1...lambda_{i0−1}*lambda_{i0}^{R−i0+1}).
items.locator: arXiv v1, Lemma 3.5 pp.9–10, second part
items.note: Paper-specialized statement; no declaration for the quantitative assertion was found at the pins.

items.name: Nonzero count below the last minimum scale
items.statement: For rank-R Lambda⊂R^N, M>0 with M<lambda_1, Y≥lambda_R, 0≤R0≤R−1 and 0<T≤Y, #((Lambda\{0})∩B_N(T))≪_R T^{R−R0}Y^{R0}/det(Lambda)+(T/M)^{R−R0−1}.
items.locator: arXiv v1, Lemma 3.6 pp.10–11, first part
items.note: Paper-specialized statement; no declaration for the quantitative assertion was found at the pins.

items.name: Two-threshold small-vector count
items.statement: Under the preceding hypotheses, let 0≤j0≤R−1, J≥M with J<lambda_{j0+1}, and 0≤R0≤R−1−j0. For 0<T≤Y the nonzero count is ≪_R T^{R−R0}Y^{R0}/det(Lambda)+(T/M)^{j0}*((T/J)^{R−R0−1−j0}+1).
items.locator: arXiv v1, Lemma 3.6 pp.10–11, second part
items.note: Paper-specialized statement; no declaration for the quantitative assertion was found at the pins.

items.name: Gcd of maximal minors
items.statement: For independent c1,...,ck∈Z^N,1≤k≤N, G(c1,...,ck) is the positive gcd of all k×k minors of their column matrix.
items.note: Paper-specialized statement; no declaration for the quantitative assertion was found at the pins.

items.name: Covolume of an integer equation lattice
items.statement: For independent c1,...,ck∈Z^N,1≤k≤N−1, det(intersection_i Lambda_ci)=det(Zc1⊕...⊕Zck)/G(c1,...,ck). The intersection has rank N−k and is primitive.
items.note: Paper-specialized statement; no declaration for the quantitative assertion was found at the pins.

items.name: Two congruence kernels
items.statement: For N≥2,Q≥1 integral and independent primitive c,d∈Z^N, det(Lambda_c^(Q)∩Lambda_d^(Q))=Q²/gcd(G(c,d),Q).
items.locator: arXiv v1, Lemma 3.9 pp.11–12, first part
items.note: Paper-specialized statement; no declaration for the quantitative assertion was found at the pins.

items.name: One exact and one congruence equation
items.statement: For N≥2,Q≥1 integral and independent primitive c,d∈Z^N, det(Lambda_c∩Lambda_d^(Q))=||c||Q/gcd(G(c,d),Q).
items.locator: arXiv v1, Lemma 3.9 pp.11–12, second part
items.note: Paper-specialized statement; no declaration for the quantitative assertion was found at the pins.

items.name: Degree-d homogeneous polynomials
items.statement: R[X_0,...,X_n]_(d) is the real vector subspace of polynomials whose supported monomials all have total degree d; zero is included.
items.note: Read Mathlib/RingTheory/MvPolynomial/Homogeneous.lean:91–109 at 082e2d3.

items.name: Lexicographic coefficient isomorphism
items.statement: For d,n≥1, M_{d,n} is the finite lexicographically ordered set of degree-d monomials; omega_d:R[X]_(d)≃_R R^N sends a form to its coefficients in that order.
items.note: Paper-specialized statement; no declaration for the quantitative assertion was found at the pins.

items.name: Veronese preserves the two-column gcd
items.statement: For d,n≥1 and independent primitive x,y∈Z^{n+1}, G(nu_{d,n}(x),nu_{d,n}(y))=G(x,y).
items.note: Paper-specialized statement; no declaration for the quantitative assertion was found at the pins.

items.name: Minimal containing-lattice covolume
items.statement: For n≥1, nonzero x∈Z^{n+1} and 2≤r≤n+1, d_r(x) is the minimum covolume of a rank-r integral lattice containing x.
items.note: Paper-specialized statement; no declaration for the quantitative assertion was found at the pins.

items.name: Minimal pair-containing covolume
items.statement: For independent x,y∈Z^{n+1} and 2≤r≤n+1, d_r(x,y) is the minimum covolume of a rank-r integral lattice containing both.
items.note: Paper-specialized statement; no declaration for the quantitative assertion was found at the pins.

items.name: Saturated plane lattice
items.statement: For independent x,y∈Z^{n+1}, L(x,y)=(Rx⊕Ry)∩Z^{n+1}; it is the unique primitive rank-two containing lattice and det L(x,y)=d_2(x,y).
items.note: Paper-specialized statement; no declaration for the quantitative assertion was found at the pins.

items.name: Saturated plane determinant
items.statement: For independent x,y∈Z^{n+1}, d_2(x,y)=sqrt(||x||²||y||²−<x,y>²)/G(x,y).
items.note: Paper-specialized statement; no declaration for the quantitative assertion was found at the pins.

items.name: Largest minimum of a Veronese kernel
items.statement: For d,n≥1 and primitive x∈Z^{n+1}, lambda_{N−1}(Lambda_{nu(x)})≤n||x||/d_2(x).
items.note: Paper-specialized statement; no declaration for the quantitative assertion was found at the pins.

items.name: Largest minimum of a double Veronese kernel
items.statement: For d,n≥2 and independent primitive x,y∈Z^{n+1}, lambda_{N−2}(Lambda_{nu(x)}∩Lambda_{nu(y)})≤3n² max{d_2(x,y)/d_3(x,y),||x||||y||/d_2(x,y)²}. Correct the degree-spanning proof using the degree-two ideal piece (E1); no change to the asserted bound.
items.note: Paper-specialized statement; no declaration for the quantitative assertion was found at the pins.

items.name: Quadratic Veronese plane and three-space lattices
items.statement: For n≥2 and independent primitive x,y, Q2=(Rnu_2(x)+Rnu_2(y))∩Z^{N_2}; Q3=(Rnu_2(x)+Rnu_2(y)+Rnu_2(x+y))∩Z^{N_2}. Their ranks are 2 and 3; Q3/Q2 is an orthogonal rank-one quotient.
items.note: Paper-specialized statement; no declaration for the quantitative assertion was found at the pins.

items.name: Quadratic quotient covolume lower bound
items.statement: For n≥2 and independent primitive x,y, det(Q3(x,y)/Q2(x,y))≥d_2(x,y)²/(3||x||||y||).
items.note: Paper-specialized statement; no declaration for the quantitative assertion was found at the pins.

items.name: Primitive lattices with prescribed minima
items.statement: For n≥2,1≤r≤n+1 and s_j≥1, S_{r,n}(s1,...,sr) is the set of primitive rank-r L⊂Z^{n+1} with s_j/2<lambda_j(L)≤s_j for every j.
items.note: Paper-specialized statement; no declaration for the quantitative assertion was found at the pins.

items.name: Counting primitive lattices by minima
items.statement: For n≥2,1≤r≤n+1 and all s_j≥1, #S_{r,n}(s1,...,sr)≪_n product_{j=1}^r s_j^{n+r+2−2j}.
items.note: Paper-specialized statement; no declaration for the quantitative assertion was found at the pins.

items.name: Vectors in small-determinant lattices
items.note: Paper-specialized statement; no declaration for the quantitative assertion was found at the pins.

items.name: Pairs in small-determinant lattices
items.statement: ell_{r,n}(X,Y;D) counts independent pairs (x,y)∈Z^{n+1}×Z^{n+1} with ||x||≤X,||y||≤Y,d_r(x,y)≤D, for X,Y,D≥1 and 2≤r≤n+1.
items.note: Paper-specialized statement; no declaration for the quantitative assertion was found at the pins.

items.name: Small containing lattice: one vector
items.statement: For n≥2,2≤r≤n+1,X,D≥1, ell_{r,n}(X;D)≪_n X^r D^n log(2D). The printed log D fails at D=1.
items.locator: arXiv v1, Lemma 3.19 p.20, endpoint correction E3
items.note: Paper-specialized statement; no declaration for the quantitative assertion was found at the pins.

items.name: Small containing lattice: independent pairs
items.statement: For n≥2,2≤r≤n+1,X,Y,D≥1, ell_{r,n}(X,Y;D)≪_n X^r Y^r D^{n−1} (log(2D))^{2 min{r−2,1}}.
items.locator: arXiv v1, Lemma 3.20 pp.20–21, endpoint correction E3
items.note: Paper-specialized statement; no declaration for the quantitative assertion was found at the pins.

items.name: Quartic-threefold short-kernel pairs
items.statement: For Z,D,M≥1 and 1≤j≤68, ell^(j)(Z;D,M) counts independent x,y∈Z^5 with ||x||,||y||≤Z, d_3(x,y)≤D and lambda_j(Lambda_{nu_4,4(x)}∩Lambda_{nu_4,4(y)})≤M. N(4,4)=70.
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure.

items.name: Rare short first minimum for quartic threefolds
items.statement: For every epsilon>0 and Z,D,M≥1, ell^(1)(Z;D,M)≪_epsilon M^40 Z^4 D*(M^30 Z² D^epsilon+M^30 D^{8/3}+Z² D)*(log(2D))². Endpoint repaired by E3; original-source uniformity and polynomial-grid proof repair remain dependencies.
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure. The dyadic range is s_1 ≤ s_2 ≤ min{Z, s_3} (E14). The fibre count (3.31) uses grid-zero-bound (E5); the reducible forms lie on a variety of dimension 39, so M^40 is a valid overcount.

items.name: Interpolated quartic first-minimum bound
items.statement: For Z,D,M≥1, ell^(1)(Z;D,M)≪Z^{9/2}D²*(Z^{3/2}+D^{3/2})*(log(2D))²*min{D,M^53}, with an absolute constant; corrected logarithmic endpoint.
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure.

items.name: Quartic Veronese lattice of a rank-three lattice
items.statement: For rank-three integral L⊂Z^5, V(L)=span_Q(nu_4,4(L))∩Z^70 is a primitive rank-15 lattice.
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure.

items.name: Rank-three quartic span covolume
items.statement: For rank-three integral L⊂Z^5, det V(L)≪(det L)^20, with an absolute constant.
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure.

items.name: Rare small 56th minimum
items.statement: For Z,D,J≥1, ell^(56)(Z;D,J)≪Z^4 D^24 J^15, with an absolute constant. The dual-lattice ball in the proof is B_70(J), not B_5(J) (E7).
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure. Same dyadic-range misprint as E14; V(L)^* ∩ B_70(J), not B_5(J) (E7).

items.name: Key variance bound
items.statement: For d≥2,n≥d, excluding (2,2),(3,3), and B/(log B)^{1/2}≤A≤B², sum_{V∈V(A)}(N_V(B)−N_V^loc(B))²/#V(A)≪B/A.
items.locator: arXiv v1, Prop.4.1 pp.26–27 and §4.6 pp.49–50
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure. (4.71) is justified with the all-cutoff first moment bound (E18).

items.name: One-band intrinsic section volume
items.statement: For independent w,z∈R^N, I(w,z)=vol_{N−1}{t∈(Rw)^perp:|<z,t>|≤||t||≤1}. Set delta(w,z)=||w||²||z||²−<w,z>²>0.
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure.

items.name: One-band volume estimate
items.statement: For N≥3 and independent w,z∈R^N, I(w,z)=2(N−2)/(N−1)*V_{N−2}*||w||/sqrt(delta)*(1+O_N(min{1,||w||²/delta})).
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure.

items.name: Two-band ambient volume
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure.

items.name: Two-band volume estimate
items.statement: For N≥3 and independent w,z∈R^N, J(w,z)=4(N−2)/N*V_{N−2}/sqrt(delta)*(1+O_N(min{1,(||w||+||z||)²/delta})).
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure.

items.name: Double Veronese kernel covolume bounds
items.statement: For d,n≥2 and independent primitive x,y∈Z^{n+1}, d_2(x,y)||x||^{d−1}||y||^{d−1}≪det(Lambda_{nu(x)}∩Lambda_{nu(y)})≪||x||^d||y||^d.
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure. For d = 2 the intermediate constant 1/4 in the proof must be 1/8 (E16); the bounds are unchanged.

items.name: Off-diagonal primitive pairs
items.statement: Omega(B)={(x,y)∈Xi(B)²:x≠y and x≠−y}. Primitive pairs in Omega are linearly independent over Q.
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure.

items.name: Inverse-covolume second-moment main sum
items.statement: E_{d,n}(B)=sum_{(x,y)∈Omega(B)}1/det(Lambda_{nu(x)}∩Lambda_{nu(y)}).
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure.

items.name: Inverse-covolume average
items.statement: For d≥2,n≥d excluding (2,2), B²≪E_{d,n}(B)≪B².
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure.

items.name: Veronese angular reciprocal
items.statement: For independent x,y, Delta(x,y)=||nu(x)|| ||nu(y)||/sqrt(||nu(x)||²||nu(y)||²−<nu(x),nu(y)>²), so Delta≥1.
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure.

items.name: Weighted inverse-covolume error sum
items.statement: For (x,y)∈Omega(B), e_{x,y}(B)=min{1,Delta(x,y)²/alpha²}+1_{G(x,y) does not divide W/rad(W)}. F(B)=sum_Omega e_{x,y}(B)/det(Lambda_{nu(x)}∩Lambda_{nu(y)}).
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure.

items.name: Saving in the inverse-covolume error
items.statement: For d≥2,n≥d excluding (2,2), F_{d,n}(B)≪B²/(log B)^{1/2}.
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure.

items.name: Extended-range first moment
items.statement: For d≥2,n≥d and A≥B^{4/5}, sum_{V∈V(A)}N_V(B)/#V(A)≪B/A.
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure. The proof's bounds (4.18) and the unsimplified bound for M^(2) hold for every cutoff t ≥ 1; the partial summation in (4.71) needs them below B^{4/5} (E18).

items.name: Off-diagonal global second moment
items.statement: D(A,B)=sum_{V∈V(A)}(N_V(B)²−N_V(B)).
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure.

items.name: Off-diagonal mixed moment
items.statement: D^mix(A,B)=sum_V(N_V(B)N_V^loc(B)−Delta_V^mix(B)), where Delta_V^mix=alpha W/(2||a_V||)*sum_{x∈Xi(B),f_a(x)=0}1/||nu(x)||.
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure.

items.name: Off-diagonal localized second moment
items.statement: D^loc(A,B)=sum_V((N_V^loc(B))²−Delta_V^loc(B)), where Delta_V^loc=alpha²W²/(2||a_V||²)*sum over localized x∈Xi(B) of 1/||nu(x)||².
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure.

items.name: Primitive and unrestricted weighted lattice sums
items.statement: For integral Lambda⊂Z^N, bounded region R and integer k≥0, S_k*(Lambda;R)=sum_{a∈Lambda∩Z_prim^N∩R}||a||^{−k}; S_k(Lambda;R)=sum_{a∈(Lambda\{0})∩R}||a||^{−k}.
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure.

items.name: Common moment constant
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure.

items.name: Global moment outside quartic threefolds
items.statement: For d≥2,n≥d excluding (2,2),(3,3),(4,4), and A≥B/log B, D(A,B)=iota A^{N−2}E(B)*(1+O((log A)^{9/2}/A^{1/2})).
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure.

items.name: Global moment for quartic threefolds
items.statement: For (d,n)=(4,4) and A≥B/log B, D(A,B)=iota A^{68}E(B)*(1+O(A^{−1/21})).
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure.

items.name: Mixed moment asymptotic
items.statement: For d≥2,n≥d excluding (2,2), and B^{5/6}≤A≤B², D^mix(A,B)=iota A^{N−2}E(B)*(1+O((log A)^{−1/2})). Use reciprocal determinants directly to repair E6.
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure.

items.name: Localized moment asymptotic
items.statement: For d≥2,n≥d excluding (2,2), and B^{1/2}≤A≤B², D^loc(A,B)=iota A^{N−2}E(B)*(1+O((log A)^{−1/2})). Use the reciprocal-determinant form in E6.
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure.

items.name: Finite-window real factor
items.statement: For a∈R^N,gamma>0, tau(a;gamma)=gamma*vol_{n+1}{u∈B_{n+1}(1):|f_a(u)|≤||a|| ||nu(u)||/(2gamma)}.
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure.

items.name: Primitive residue vectors
items.statement: For integers Q,m≥1, R_m(Q)={b∈(Z/QZ)^m:gcd(Q,b_1,...,b_m)=1}.
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure.

items.name: Finite-modulus local density
items.statement: For a∈Z^N and Q≥1, sigma(a;Q)=Q^{−n}*#{b∈R_{n+1}(Q):f_a(b)=0 mod Q}. It depends only on a mod Q.
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure.

items.name: Smoothing factors for a hypersurface
items.statement: J_V(B)=tau(a_V;alpha(B)); S_V(B)=sigma(a_V;W(B)). Both are independent of the sign of a_V. No limit to singular factors is used in the proof.
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure.

items.name: Localized count controls the product of factors
items.statement: For d≥2,n≥d,V∈V(A) and B sufficiently large, S_V(B)J_V(B)≪(A/B)N_V^loc(B)+B^{−1/n}.
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure.

items.name: Finite-place factor lower tail
items.statement: For integers d≥2,n≥3 (no n≥d restriction), C>0, phi:R_{>0}→R_{>1} with phi(A)≤A eventually, #{V∈V^loc(A):S_V(Aphi(A))<Cphi(A)^{−1/6}}/#V^loc(A)≪_{d,n,C}phi(A)^{−1/(24n)}.
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure.

items.name: Real factor lower tail
items.statement: For integers d≥2,n≥3, C>0, and phi:R_{>0}→R_{>1} with phi(A)≤A eventually, #{V∈V^loc(A):J_V(Aphi(A))<Cphi(A)^{−1/6}}/#V^loc(A)≪_{d,n,C}phi(A)^{−1/(6n)}.
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure.

items.name: First moment of a prime-power density
items.statement: For d≥2,n≥3, prime p and integer r≥1, the average of sigma(a;p^r) over a∈R_N(p^r) equals (1−p^{−n−1})(1−p^{−N+1})/(1−p^{−N})=1+O_{d,n}(p^{−n−1}).
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure.

items.name: Variance of a prime-power density
items.statement: For d≥2,n≥3, prime p and r≥1, average_{a∈R_N(p^r)}(sigma(a;p^r)−1)²≪_{d,n}p^{−n+1}, uniformly in r.
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure.

items.name: Finite-level locally soluble coefficient set
items.statement: F^loc_{d,n}(Q)={a∈R_N(Q):for every p^r exactly dividing Q, some x∈R_{n+1}(p^r) satisfies f_a(x)=0 mod p^r}.
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure.

items.name: Prime-power gradient strata
items.statement: For prime p,r≥1 and 0≤e≤r, R_N^(e)(p^r) consists of a∈R_N(p^r) with a primitive zero x mod p^r and v_p(grad f_a(x))=e. Vector valuation is capped at r. F^loc(p^r)=union_{e=0}^r R_N^(e)(p^r); these sets may overlap.
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure.

items.name: Rare high-valuation gradient witness
items.statement: For d≥2,n≥3, prime p,r≥1 and 1≤e≤r, #R_N^(e)(p^r)≤2p^{rN−e}.
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure.

items.name: Density from a controlled-gradient zero
items.statement: For d≥2,n≥3, prime p,r≥1,0≤e≤r and a∈R_N^(e)(p^r), sigma(a;p^r)≥p^{−(e+1)n}. The proof splits e=r, r≤2e+1, and the Hensel-lifting range r≥2e+2.
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure.

items.name: Real-soluble coefficient cone
items.statement: I^loc_{d,n}={a∈R^N\{0}:∃x∈S^n,f_a(x)=0}. It includes forms whose every real zero is singular.
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure.

items.name: Lattice points near the real-solubility boundary
items.statement: N(a)=a+B_N(1); U(A)={a∈Z^N∩B_N(A)∩I^loc:N(a) is not contained in I^loc}.
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure.

items.name: Real-solubility boundary estimate
items.statement: For d≥2,n≥3, #U(A)≪_{d,n}A^{N−1}. Repair the crossing construction to include time zero as in E4.
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure.

items.name: Real regular-zero gradient strata
items.statement: M_{d,n}=max_{||a||=||x||=1}||grad f_a(x)||. For lambda>0, B_N^(lambda)={a∈B_N(1):∃x∈S^n,f_a(x)=0 and lambda||a||<||grad f_a(x)||≤2lambda||a||}. The dyadic union equals the regular-real-zero locus in B_N(1), not all I^loc (E2).
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure.

items.name: Volume of small-gradient real-zero stratum
items.statement: For d≥2,n≥3 and 0<lambda<M_{d,n}, vol_N(B_N^(lambda))≪_{d,n}lambda². The neighborhood comparison must use an enlarged lambda scale (E10).
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure.

items.name: Real factor from a regular zero
items.statement: For d≥2,n≥3,gamma>0,0<lambda<M_{d,n} and a∈B_N^(lambda), tau(a;gamma)≫_{d,n}lambda^{n+1}min{gamma,lambda^{−2}}. Repair the unweighted Veronese norm constant as in E8.
items.note: Named-source result/explicit proof construction. This item is not a claim of formalisation or completed prerequisite closure. In (5.34) the gradient bounds are λ/2^{d−1} and λ/2^{d−2} (E17); the norm comparison is E8.

items.name: Existing full-lattice carrier
items.statement: In a normed K-vector space E, for a discrete Z-submodule L, IsZLattice K L asserts span_K(L)=top. Apply it to span_R Lambda, not necessarily the original R^N.
items.note: Mathlib/Algebra/Module/ZLattice/Basic.lean:432–436; statement read at 082e2d3.

items.name: Existing full-lattice covolume
items.statement: ZLattice.covolume L mu is (addCovolume L E mu).toReal. For finite-dimensional real E, discrete full lattice L and additive Haar mu, it equals mu.real F for any additive fundamental domain F.
items.note: Mathlib/Algebra/Module/ZLattice/Covolume.lean:72–86; also covolume_eq_measure_fundamentalDomain.

items.name: Existing covolume-index identity
items.statement: For finite-dimensional real inner-product E and discrete full lattices L1≤L2, covolume(L1)/covolume(L2)=[L2:L1] (relative additive subgroup index).
items.note: Mathlib/Algebra/Module/ZLattice/Covolume.lean:174–189; all measurable/Borel instances and full-rank hypotheses retained.

items.name: Existing integral-pairing submodule
items.statement: For a bilinear form B over field S, R-algebra S and compatible R/S-modules M, B.dualSubmodule N={x:∀y∈N,B(x,y)∈1_R}, where 1_R is the R-span of 1 in S. This supplies the integer-pairing carrier after restricting to the real span.
items.note: Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/BilinearForm/DualLattice.lean:37–47. TauCeti's stronger dualSubmoduleEquivDual was read but assumes a fraction-field setting; not claimed to apply directly to Z⊂R.

items.name: Poonen–Voloch local-solubility density
items.statement: For n,d≥2 excluding (n,d)=(2,2), counting all integral degree-d forms with coefficient sup norm≤H, Nloc(H)/(2 floor(H)+1)^N tends to product_v c_v>0. Each c_v is normalized local coefficient measure of forms with a nontrivial Q_v-zero. Primitive coefficient restriction preserves this limit. The Euclidean-ball version used here needs its own shape-transfer proof.
items.note: Original author PDF pp.1–3, Remark 2.1 and Thm.3.6, read 2026-09-22; Euclidean transfer is G2. The Euclidean form actually used is pv-density-ball (E19).

items.name: Plane conics have local density zero
items.statement: For Euclidean-height ordered plane conics, rho^loc_{2,2}=0. Source reports Serre's upper bound; original source and the height-shape transfer remain to acquire.
items.note: Reported input, not independently source-closed.

items.name: Le Boudec least-point lower scale
items.statement: For d≥2,n≥d,(d,n)≠(2,2), and psi:R_{>0}→R_{>0} with psi(u)=o(u), #{V∈V(A):M(V)>psi(||a_V||)}/#V(A)→1.
items.note: Original arXiv:2006.02288v1 Thm.1 pp.2–3 read.

items.name: Primitive lattice points in a Euclidean ball
items.statement: For N≥3,3≤R≤N, primitive integral rank-R Lambda, Y≥1 with R independent vectors in B_N(Y), and T≥Y, #(Lambda∩Z_prim^N∩B_N(T))=V_R T^R/(zeta(R)det Lambda)*(1+O_R(Y/T))+O_R(T log(2Y)). The replacement of log Y by log(2Y) keeps the endpoint harmless.
items.note: Le Boudec arXiv:2006.02288v1 p.7 statement and beginning of proof read; full proof not yet source-closed.

items.name: Uniform definable-family lattice counting
items.statement: For positive m,k and a definable family Z⊂R^{m+k} in a fixed o-minimal expansion containing semialgebraic sets, with bounded fibers Z_t, there exists C_Z depending only on Z such that for every full lattice Lambda⊂R^k and t, |#(Z_t∩Lambda)−vol(Z_t)/det Lambda|≤C_Z sum_{j=0}^{k−1} V_j(Z_t)/(lambda_1...lambda_j). V_j is the sum of j-dimensional coordinate-projection volumes; j=0 term is 1.
items.locator: arXiv v1, §3.1 p.9; §5.1 p.51, input [2] Thm.1.3
items.note: Barroero–Widmer arXiv:1210.5943v2 pp.1–5 read, including precise Thm.1.3. Proof closure remains open.

items.name: Hasse–Minkowski input for quadratic forms
items.statement: For a finite-dimensional regular quadratic form over a number field K, global isotropy is equivalent to isotropy at every finite and real completion. Singular forms require handling their rational radical separately.
items.note: Read complete atlas Layer 5 and reviewed RP.2 audit. Not built at the pinned libraries.

items.name: No Brauer obstruction for high-dimensional complete intersections
items.statement: For characteristic-zero field k and smooth complete intersection X⊂P^n_k of dimension≥3, Br(k)→Br(X) is an isomorphism (cohomological Brauer groups). Over a number field its Brauer–Manin obstruction is consequently vacuous; this does not prove rational solubility.
items.locator: arXiv v1, §1 p.2, input [16] Appendix A
items.note: Poonen–Voloch author PDF Appendix A pp.4–5 read; original cohomological prerequisite closure open.

items.name: Corrected two-point homogeneous spanning lemma
items.statement: For independent x,y∈R^{n+1}, n≥1, and d≥2, let I_d={Q homogeneous of degree d:Q(x)=Q(y)=0}. Then I_d is spanned by P Q with P a degree-(d−2) monomial and Q∈I_2. After a real linear coordinate change sending x,y to e0,e1, the ideal is (X2,...,Xn,X0X1), and every allowed degree-d monomial has a degree-two divisor in I_2.
items.locator: arXiv v1, Lemma 3.15 p.18, repair E1
items.note: Explicit repair proved in report; finite monomial tests are regression checks, not a Lean proof.

items.name: Real singular-only exception is null
items.statement: For d≥2,n≥3, forms having a real projective zero but no regular real projective zero form a Lebesgue-null subset of coefficient space. They lie in the vanishing locus of the nonzero homogeneous-form discriminant. Therefore the dyadic stratum cover suffices almost everywhere for the nonnegative integral on p.65.
items.note: Repair requires discriminant construction/nonzero and polynomial zero-set nullity (G6); alternatively prove nullity by the coefficient-incidence estimate in Lemma 5.9.

items.name: Uniform reciprocal congruence determinants
items.statement: For independent primitive x,y, squarefree ell≥1 and Q=W/gcd(ell,W), set G=G(x,y), I=1_{G does not divide W/rad(W)}. Then det(Gamma_mix(Q))^{-1}=gcd(ell,W)G/(W||nu(x)||)*(1+O(I)); det(Gamma_loc(Q))^{-1}=gcd(ell,W)²G/W²*(1+O(I)), each with absolute O constant 1. Indeed gcd(G,Q)/G lies in (0,1] and equals 1 when I=0.
items.note: This repairs the inversion step without any lower bound for gcd(G,Q)/G on the bad set.

items.name: Correct unweighted monomial norm comparison
items.statement: For d≥1,n≥1 and u∈R^{n+1}, (n+1)^{−d/2}||u||^d≤||nu_{d,n}(u)||≤||u||^d. Lower bound: retain the pure dth power of a maximum coordinate. Upper bound: expand (sum u_i²)^d and note all multinomial coefficients are at least 1.
items.note: The paper's unit-constant lower bound is false; dimensional constants suffice in Lemma 5.10.

items.name: Primitive extensions of a fixed primitive lattice
items.statement: Let n ≥ 2, 2 ≤ r ≤ n+1 and let L' ⊂ Z^{n+1} be a primitive lattice of rank r−1. The number of primitive lattices L ⊂ Z^{n+1} of rank r containing L' with det(L)/det(L') ≤ s is ≪_n s^{n−r+2}·det(L'). (As used with det(L') ≪ s_1⋯s_{r−1} and s = s_r.)
items.locator: arXiv v1, proof of Lemma 3.18 p.19, input [17] Lemma 6 (i = 1)
items.note: Cited input (Schmidt 1968). Original not read by cc-442dc5; the statement is the form the proof uses.

items.name: Basis adapted to the successive minima
items.statement: Every lattice L ⊂ R^N of rank R has a basis b_1,…,b_R with λ_j(L) ≤ ||b_j|| ≪_R λ_j(L) for all j, such that every x = t_1b_1 + ⋯ + t_Rb_R ∈ L satisfies |t_j| ≪_R ||x||/λ_j(L).
items.locator: arXiv v1, proofs of Lemmas 3.21 p.22–23 and 3.23 p.24, input [12] Lemma 5
items.note: Cited input (Davenport 1963). Original not read by cc-442dc5.

items.name: Uniform count on absolutely irreducible quartic threefolds
items.statement: For every ε > 0 and every absolutely irreducible quartic form F in five variables, #{b ∈ Z^5: ||b|| ≤ s, F(b) = 0} ≪_ε s^{3+ε}, with the implied constant independent of F.
items.locator: arXiv v1, proof of Lemma 3.21 p.22 (3.28), input [5] Theorem 1
items.note: Cited input (Broberg–Salberger 2004), read by the paper through the projective count; the affine-cone count follows by summing over multiples. Original not read by cc-442dc5.

items.name: Zeros of a ternary quartic in an ordered box
items.statement: Let g ∈ R[t_1,t_2,t_3] be a nonzero polynomial of degree at most 4 and H_1 ≥ H_2 ≥ H_3 > 0. The number of integer points with |t_j| ≤ H_j and g(t) = 0 is ≪ (H_1+1)(H_2+1), with an absolute implied constant.
items.locator: arXiv v1, proof of Lemma 3.21 p.23 before (3.31), repair E5
items.note: Repair of E5 (checkpoint argument, checked by cc-442dc5): expand g in t_3; fibres with a nonzero coefficient have at most four roots, and the remaining (t_1,t_2) lie on the zero set of one nonzero binary coefficient polynomial, which has O(H_1+1) grid points.

items.name: Hensel lifting at a fixed gradient valuation
items.statement: Let f be a form with integer coefficients, p prime, x ∈ Z^{n+1} primitive with f(x) ≡ 0 mod p^{2e+1} and v_p(∇f(x)) = e. For s ≥ 2e+2 the number C(s) of b mod p^s with b ≡ x mod p^{e+1} and f(b) ≡ 0 mod p^s satisfies C(s)/p^{sn} = C(s−1)/p^{(s−1)n}.
items.locator: arXiv v1, proof of Lemma 5.7 p.57, input [6] Lemma 3.3
items.note: Cited input (Browning–Matthiesen 2017). Original not read by cc-442dc5.

items.name: A positive proportion of plane cubics have a rational point
items.statement: When integral ternary cubic forms are ordered by the maximum of their coefficients, a positive proportion have a nontrivial rational zero.
items.locator: arXiv v1, §1 p.3 before Corollary 1.2, input [3] Theorem 2
items.note: Cited input (Bhargava, arXiv:1402.1131v1). Used for cubic surfaces with a rational point on x_3 = 0. The Euclidean ordering needs only the inscribed box [−A/√20, A/√20]^20 (cc-442dc5). Original not read.

items.name: Local-solubility density for the Euclidean ordering
items.statement: For n ≥ d ≥ 2 with (d,n) ≠ (2,2), #V^loc_{d,n}(A)/#V_{d,n}(A) tends to c_∞^{ball} ∏_p c_p > 0 as A → ∞, where V_{d,n}(A) counts primitive coefficient classes of Euclidean norm at most A, c_p is the p-adic local density and c_∞^{ball} is the proportion of the Euclidean unit ball occupied by coefficient vectors of forms with a nontrivial real zero.
items.locator: arXiv v1, §1 p.2 (1.3), as used; repair E19
items.note: The paper cites Poonen–Voloch Theorem 3.6, which is for sup-norm boxes over all coefficient vectors. The same sieve over Euclidean balls, with PV Remark 2.1(2) for primitivity, gives this form (E19).
